title: Breath pacer
fits: A screen that should stay alive while nobody touches it: line drawings with dots at constant speed, a slow breath, and a quick crossfade between drawings.
wrongFor: Motion the visitor drives by hand, or motion that must land and rest; this loop never rests while it is on screen.
feel: Slow and even: the dots run at constant speed with no rest and no landing, and the breath is a disc hollow that grows and shrinks on straight ramps over a 4.0 s loop. A mode swap takes about 0.38 s: a 0.985 scale dip and a small title nudge, then a crossfade, with no overshoot.

drawing.draw: DRAW[i](tm, alpha) on #art, in u units from the drawing center; exactly 5 modes, one drawing each in MODES and DRAW, because the fixed swap schedule (scheduleCuts) names modes 1 to 4
